only_the_project_list_entry_is_removed_s: Only the project list entry is removed. Server files and session history are preserved.
add_the_same_directory_later_to_access_i: Add the same directory later to access its history again. Finish running tasks and resolve unconfirmed operations first.
enter_an_existing_absolute_path_on_the_s: Enter an existing absolute path on the server, not this browser's device. The service must have access.
work_dir_path_help: Use an existing directory on the server. Relative paths use workDir from Service configuration; absolute paths are used directly.
work_dir_clone_help: Defaults to workDir/repository-name when configured. You can edit it; relative paths use workDir and absolute paths are used directly. The parent must exist and be writable.
your_login_expired_log_in_again_to_manag: Your login expired. Log in again to manage projects.
set_a_recognizable_project_name_or_remov: Set a recognizable project name, or remove it from the workspace.
add_an_existing_directory_on_the_server_: Add an existing directory on the server running Codex Web UI to view history and start tasks.
code_and_credentials_stay_on_the_compute: Code and credentials stay on the computer running the service
no_sessions_yet_create_one_to_get_starte: No sessions yet. Create one to get started.
local_list_sync_failed_browsing_is_still: Local list sync failed; browsing is still available.
showing_local_list_syncing_in_background: Showing local list; syncing in background…
some_local_entries_are_not_synced_load_m: Some local entries are not synced. Load more to verify.
no_matching_projects_or_loaded_sessions: No matching projects or loaded sessions.
no_projects_yet_add_a_server_directory_t: No projects yet. Add a server directory to get started.
copy_failed_select_and_copy_the_id_manua: Copy failed. Select and copy the ID manually.
source_records_the_client_used_at_creati: Source records the client used at creation, not the current execution location or connection state.
fork_session_copy_saved_history_both_ses: Fork session: copy saved history. Both sessions can run simultaneously.
enter_to_save_esc_to_cancel_up_to: Enter to save · Esc to cancel · Up to {{v0}} characters
created_by_the_codex_terminal_cli: Created by the Codex terminal CLI.
created_by_the_codex_extension_in_vs_cod: Created by the Codex extension in VS Code.
created_by_the_codex_desktop_app: Created by the Codex desktop app.
recorded_as_a_codex_terminal_cli_source: Recorded as a Codex terminal CLI source.
codex_only_recorded_an_interactive_sourc: Codex only recorded an interactive source category. It may be web, terminal or IDE; the exact client is unknown.
recorded_as_a_codex_mcp_service_source: Recorded as a Codex MCP service source.
recorded_as_a_non_interactive_codex_comm: Recorded as a non-interactive Codex command-line task.
no_recognizable_creator_codex_source_is_: No recognizable creator; Codex source is recorded as “{{v0}}”.
the_session_service_restarted_retry_load: The session service restarted. Retry loading sessions.
session_pagination_did_not_advance_retry: Session pagination did not advance. Retry or refresh the session list.
too_many_session_pages_read_retry_or_ref: Too many session pages read. Retry or refresh the session list.
enter_to_save_esc_to_cancel_up_to_other: Enter to save · Esc to cancel · Up to {{v0}} characters
enter_to_save_esc_to_cancel_up_to_one: Enter to save · Esc to cancel · Up to {{v0}} character
clone_intro: Clone a Git repository to the server running Covro. The project is added automatically when cloning finishes.
clone_auth_help: Supports HTTPS and SSH (for example, git@github.com:owner/repo.git). Uses the server’s existing Git credentials. Do not include passwords or tokens in the URL.
clone_path_help: Enter an absolute path on the server. Its parent directory must exist and be writable. The destination must be absent or empty; existing files will not be overwritten.
clone_background_help: Closing or refreshing the page does not cancel cloning. To stop, choose “Cancel clone”.
no_sessions_yet: No sessions yet. Start a session directly or add a project.
clone_stage_cancelling: Cancelling; waiting for Git to exit…
clone_stage_registration_failed: Clone completed; project not yet added
clone_stage_timed_out: Clone timed out and was stopped
order_help: Drag projects or use the arrow buttons to reorder. New or restored projects appear at the end.
order_auto_save: Changes save automatically and survive refreshes and restarts.
